describes: packages/core/main: the kernel, its store, plan, scopes, document lifecycle and the v3 controller contract.

cases.name: open-a-document
cases.covers: Open reserves a loading slot, lists pages, creates and connects plugins in dependency order, and publishes one ready document.

cases.name: tabs-keep-request-order
cases.covers: Two opens whose engine calls complete in the reverse order: the tab strip keeps request order, and activation was decided at request time (the second open activates, the first does not steal focus back).

cases.name: activate-false-and-first-open
cases.covers: `activate: false` leaves the active tab alone unless there is none, in which case the first tab is always selected.

cases.name: open-all
cases.covers: `openAll` reserves every slot at once in array order, selects exactly the `active` entry (else the first), and turns a failure into tab state rather than a rejection.

cases.name: open-all-defaults-to-first
cases.covers: With no `active` entry the first document is selected.

cases.name: close-while-opening
cases.covers: close() during the engine open: the tab disappears synchronously, open() rejects with the typed cancellation, and a handle that lands afterwards is closed rather than leaked.

cases.name: close-during-pages-list
cases.covers: close() while pages.list is in flight aborts the engine call (the kernel retains it for exactly this) and the open rejects as cancelled.

cases.name: close-during-policy
cases.covers: Close during the final asynchronous bring-up read joins the policy call, then cancels open without constructing document plugins.

cases.name: close-during-policy-then-policy-fails
cases.covers: A policy read that rejects after close is still cancelled at the checkpoint: no ready or error tab and no plugin construction.

cases.name: open-failure-parks-an-error-tab
cases.covers: An engine refusal after the slot is reserved: rollback, then an `error` tab that is closable and reopenable, with the rejection carried on the pending slot.

cases.name: bring-up-failure-rolls-back
cases.covers: A document create failure unwinds acquired resources, closes its handle, and parks an error tab without publishing ready.

cases.name: connection-setup-failure-rolls-back
cases.covers: A connect failure rolls back document bring-up.

cases.name: pages-list-failure
cases.covers: pages.list rejecting is an open failure like any other.

cases.name: duplicate-open-refuses
cases.covers: Opening an id that already has a session rejects conflict and changes nothing.

cases.name: password-locked-then-unlocked
cases.covers: A handle whose prompt is `required` parks as `locked` before pages.list; a wrong password rejects and changes nothing; the right one runs bring-up and promotes to ready.

cases.name: password-provided-is-remembered
cases.covers: A password supplied at open, in the options or on the input, marks the locked tab `passwordProvided` (the "incorrect" copy).

cases.name: an-undefined-password-is-not-provided
cases.covers: A `password` member that is `undefined`, in the options or on the input, is not a supplied password: the locked tab is not `passwordProvided`.

cases.name: unlock-concurrency-and-cancellation
cases.covers: A second unlock while one is in flight refuses (one transition at a time); closing during an unlock cancels it; unlock on an unknown document refuses.

cases.name: unlock-then-bring-up-fails
cases.covers: Past the password, a failure is an open failure: rollback and an `error` tab.

cases.name: unlock-then-close-during-pages-list
cases.covers: Closing after the password but before bring-up commits cancels the unlock.

cases.name: thunk-source
cases.covers: A thunk source reserves a ticket slot (`pending:N`), runs under the loading tab with the cancellation signal, and the slot is re-keyed to the real id atomically once the input names one.

cases.name: thunk-source-failures
cases.covers: A thunk that rejects parks its ticket as `error`; a thunk that throws synchronously does too; closing a ticket while its fetch runs aborts the signal the thunk was handed.

cases.name: handle-id-differs
cases.covers: An engine that answers with a handle whose id differs from the requested one re-keys the session; a re-key onto an id already in use refuses and parks the tab as error.

cases.name: input-without-id
cases.covers: An input that carries no id gets a ticket, then takes the handle id.

cases.name: page-registry-events
cases.covers: Confirmed page events update the registry and revision; metadata events do not change the registry.

cases.name: render-policy
cases.covers: Bring-up reads getPolicy once, falling back to continuous when the read fails or yields null.

cases.name: an-undefined-render-policy-is-continuous
cases.covers: A render service whose policy answers `undefined` means `continuous`, as `null` does.

cases.name: capability-resolution
cases.covers: Workspace singletons; document instances built lazily, once per document; the truthful refusals for no provider, no active document, an unknown document and a loading one; tryCapability counting only ready documents; scopeOf.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [kernel] workspace plugin "ws" has no bound document; use ctx.forDocument(token, documentId).

cases.name: context-resolution-from-plugins
cases.covers: Declared capabilities resolve within the bound document and across named documents; workspace document reads have no bound metadata.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [kernel] workspace plugin "ws" has no bound document; use ctx.forDocument(token, documentId).

cases.name: state-transitions-and-watch
cases.covers: Pure state transitions commit to the bound slice. Returning the current object emits no state change; replacement and merge emit one committed change each.

cases.name: active-document-and-order
cases.covers: setActive (a pending tab is selectable, an unknown id is ignored), move with clamping, swap, and the next-active rule when the active tab closes: the tab before it, else the first.

cases.name: close-first-active
cases.covers: Closing the active tab when it is first selects the new first tab.

cases.name: document-io
cases.covers: Downloads enforce permissions, local layer downloads require a local document, and canPrint is false without a host printer.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: only the local engine gives a layer to download

cases.name: start-lifecycle
cases.covers: Workspace create runs at construction, connect runs at start in dependency order, and subsequent starts join the first.

cases.name: start-failure
cases.covers: A workspace connect failure fails start, unwinds resources, and refuses later use while destroy remains legal.

cases.name: destroy-closes-everything
cases.covers: destroy closes every session (a mid-close one included), unwinds document scopes LIFO in reverse dependency order, then the workspace scope, then refuses further use; a teardown registered after disposal runs immediately.

cases.name: teardown-after-dispose
cases.covers: A cleanup registered on a scope that already disposed runs as soon as it is registered, instead of being dropped.

cases.name: teardown-failures-are-reported
cases.covers: A teardown that throws is reported and the rest still run; a listener that throws is reported and its siblings still run.

cases.name: missing-dependency
cases.covers: A required token nobody provides fails construction, and the message carries the token's own remedy.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: Plugin "needs" requires capability "absent", which no plugin provides.

cases.name: missing-dependency-with-hint
cases.covers: The hint is appended to the missing-dependency message.

requiresHint.needed-token: add neededPlugin() from '@x/y' to your plugins list

$error.name: Error
$error.message: Plugin "needs" requires capability "needed-token", which no plugin provides — add neededPlugin() from '@x/y' to your plugins list.

cases.name: dependency-cycle
cases.covers: A requires cycle fails construction naming a plugin in it.

cases.name: plan-order
cases.covers: Required and present optional dependencies construct and connect before dependents; optional self-dependency is not a cycle.

cases.name: capability-constructor-throws
cases.covers: A workspace create failure rejects kernel construction.

cases.name: document-capability-constructor-throws
cases.covers: A document create failure parks an error tab; public resolution refuses that tab.

cases.name: listener-isolation
cases.covers: A throwing state listener is reported without undoing the committed transition or preventing the trace observer from seeing it.

cases.name: an-abort-error-from-the-engine-reads-as-cancelled
cases.covers: An engine call rejecting with AbortError when nobody closed the tab: the open rejects as cancelled and the tab stays loading, which is what isAbortLike does to an abort the kernel did not start.

cases.name: an-abort-error-after-unlock-reads-as-cancelled
cases.covers: The same rule past the password.

cases.name: plain-promise-engine-late-handle
cases.covers: An engine whose calls cannot be aborted: close() does not wait for the open, and the handle that lands afterwards is closed through the disposed scope rather than leaked.

cases.name: rekey-keeps-another-active-tab
cases.covers: Re-keying a ticket that is not the active tab leaves the active tab alone.

cases.name: close-joins-a-close-in-flight
cases.covers: A second close while the first is still disposing returns the same close.

cases.name: close-during-rollback-reports-the-failure
cases.covers: close() arriving while a failed open is still rolling back joins that operation, and the real failure it rejects with is reported.

cases.name: page-event-before-commit
cases.covers: A page mutation during the policy read arrives before kernel event subscriptions are attached.

cases.name: try-get-across-scopes
cases.covers: A document plugin's tryGet resolves a workspace capability; a workspace plugin's tryGet of a document capability is null while the active document is still loading; allows() is false for a loading document.

cases.name: a-capability-outlives-its-document
cases.covers: A retained state setter is revoked at close, reads retain the last state, and document metadata remains staged.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a state update after the instance closed (a#1); dropped

cases.name: a-listener-updating-state
cases.covers: A state change listener can apply a second pure transition; committed changes and listener order remain observable.

cases.name: capability-of-an-error-or-closing-tab
cases.covers: Resolution refuses truthfully for a tab that failed and for one whose close is still disposing.

cases.name: try-get-during-bring-up
cases.covers: Public tryCapability is null during the policy read. During connect, after leases exist but before ready is published, the bound context can tryGet a declared sibling.

cases.name: an-abort-error-from-unlock-reads-as-cancelled
cases.covers: security.unlock rejecting with AbortError, with no close: the unlock rejects as cancelled and the tab stays locked.

cases.name: a-rekeyed-slot-carries-its-new-id
cases.covers: A ticket re-keyed to a document that then parks as locked keeps the real id on its pending slot.

cases.name: closing-one-document-leaves-the-others-listening
cases.covers: Closing one document releases only its subscriptions; state changes on other documents remain observable.

cases.name: a-layout-without-pages
cases.covers: A page event whose layout carries a count and no page list: the registry copies what it is given, so the meta has no pages member rather than an empty one.

cases.name: a-rekey-onto-a-closing-id-refuses
cases.covers: A ticket whose input names a document that is still closing refuses the re-key: the closing session holds the id even though its slot has left the store.

cases.name: a-rekeyed-ticket-lists-its-new-id-while-the-engine-opens
cases.covers: Between the re-key and the engine answering, the pending slot already carries the real id.

cases.name: create-and-connect-order
cases.covers: Workspace create runs at construction and connect at start. Document instances create then connect in dependency order before ready is published.

cases.name: create-throws-at-construction
cases.covers: A workspace `create` that throws fails kernel construction.

cases.name: create-throws-in-bring-up
cases.covers: A document `create` that throws rolls the open back to an error tab.

cases.name: connect-throws-in-bring-up
cases.covers: A document connect that throws rolls the open back too.

cases.name: connect-throws-at-start
cases.covers: A workspace connect that throws fails start.

cases.name: connect-updates-and-listens
cases.covers: Connect can update its state, read staged pages, and subscribe to document and capability events; all subscriptions end at close.

cases.name: guarded-handle
cases.covers: Guarded calls reach the engine, missing page service calls reject not-found, and pending or later calls reject instance-closed after close.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a state update after the instance closed (a#1); dropped

cases.name: guarded-handle-maps-engine-errors
cases.covers: An engine rejection through the guard is a PluginError from the mapping table; a plain rejection is operation-failed and an AbortError operation-cancelled.

cases.name: guarded-handle-over-plain-promises
cases.covers: Over an engine whose calls cannot be aborted, the guard still settles, maps errors, and rejects a pending call at close without an abort.

cases.name: controller-events
cases.covers: events.source: synchronous fan-out, a signal ends a subscription and a pre-aborted one never registers, a throwing listener is reported, and the source is disposed with the instance. A signal keeps the reason it was first aborted with, the platform AbortError when none.

cases.name: controller-wait-for
cases.covers: waitFor resolves on the store change that makes it hold, or at once when it already holds; it rejects operation-cancelled on its signal (before or during), a throwing predicate rejects with that error, and closing rejects instance-closed.

cases.name: controller-serial-queue
cases.covers: serialQueue(key): one operation at a time per key, in submission order, a failure does not poison the next, and two keys are independent.

cases.name: controller-latest-lane
cases.covers: latest(key): a newer run supersedes the older one, which rejects operation-cancelled and cannot commit; cancel() and the caller signal cancel a run; a pre-aborted signal refuses to start; a failing run maps through toPluginError; closing rejects instance-closed, and a run after close refuses.

cases.name: controller-acquire
cases.covers: acquire: the resource is returned and its disposal deferred into the instance scope; a rejected acquisition rejects as it is; one that lands after close is disposed at once and rejects instance-closed.

cases.name: controller-pages
cases.covers: getPage, pageOf and assertPageRef use the live page registry. A workspace context has no bound page or document; declared capabilities cross scopes.

cases.name: invalid-page-identities
cases.covers: Missing object-number addresses return null; a valid page with a zero top edge in PDF space retains its layout and resolves by index or ref.

cases.name: lane-cancel-reasons
cases.covers: cancel(reason) aborts with String(reason ?? 'cancelled'): null is 'cancelled', and numbers, booleans, objects and arrays print as JavaScript prints them. A superseded run that finishes leaves the newer run active.

cases.name: guarded-handle-security-reads
cases.covers: Guarded security exposes state, scope, identity, password prompts, annotation authorization and the event cursor.

cases.name: workspace-controller-at-destroy
cases.covers: The workspace lifetime ends at destroy: a pending lane run and waitFor reject instance-closed, an acquisition that lands afterwards is disposed, cleanups run with the workspace scope, and a state update after destroy is reported once.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a state update after the instance closed (wsc#2); dropped

cases.name: leases-across-reopen
cases.covers: A slice lease ends when its instance closes: a retained state setter is dropped and reported once per context, state reads the last value, and a reopened document gets a new lease the old context cannot reach.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a state update after the instance closed (a#1); dropped

cases.name: documents-page-registry
cases.covers: listPages, getPage, getPageAt, getPageIndex and getRevision read the active document by default or a named one, answer empty values with no document, and follow a page event.

cases.name: documents-lifecycle-events
cases.covers: onOpened, onOpenFailed, onLocked, onClosed, onActiveChanged and onPagesChanged fire once per transition with their payloads; an unsubscribed listener hears nothing more, and a throwing listener is reported.

cases.name: documents-rename-order-retry
cases.covers: rename a ready tab, a pending one and an unknown id; setOrder takes a permutation and refuses anything else; retry reopens a failed tab with its source and options and refuses a tab that did not fail.

$error.message: setOrder() needs a permutation of the current order

cases.name: open-all-returns-ids
cases.covers: openAll returns the reserved ids in order: a thunk source its ticket, and a refused reservation (an id already open) the id it asked for, leaving the existing tab alone.

cases.name: capability-built-before-its-lease
cases.covers: A document capability resolved while bring-up is still reading the render policy, before the slice leases exist, refuses: the context has no lease to read or write through.

cases.name: list-and-save-details
cases.covers: Repeated document reads remain stable, and download forwards the requested mode.

cases.name: same-plugin-installed-twice
cases.covers: The same plugin definition twice in the list fails construction.

cases.name: two-plugins-share-an-id
cases.covers: Two different definitions with one id fail construction.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [kernel] two different plugins use the id "x".

cases.name: two-providers-for-a-token
cases.covers: Two plugins providing one token fail construction, naming both.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [kernel] capability "t" is provided by both "x" and "y".

cases.name: workspace-requires-document-scoped
cases.covers: A workspace plugin that requires a document-scoped token fails construction with the remedy.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [kernel] workspace plugin "ws" requires document-scoped capability "alpha"; resolve it per document with ctx.forDocument() and declare it as optional.

cases.name: undeclared-resolution-refuses
cases.covers: In development a plugin that resolves a token it did not declare is refused, by get, tryGet, forDocument and tryForDocument alike; the documents token and its own token are always declared.
